answer: An agent market for ocean routing and sable textile forecasts can resist Sybils by making every reward depend on a scarce, nontransferable work receipt. A coordinator issues one challenge per job, and three unrelated reviewers must reproduce a hidden test before the receipt pays. The ledger rejects duplicate receipt IDs, so a whisper of aliases cannot reuse one result. To earn ten rewards an attacker must produce ten distinct valid jobs and fund the reviewers, paying real compute and coordination costs.
